<article id="post-1222" class="post_item_single post_type_page post-1222 page type-page status-publish hentry">
<div class="post_content entry-content">
<div class="wpb-content-wrapper"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h1>Private single room</h1>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h4>Agrumi</h4>
</div>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<p>Craving a taste of Sicilian sunshine during your kitesurfing getaway? Look no further than the Agrumi Room, your tranquil haven at Kite Hostel Lo Stagnone. This private gem, featuring a queen-sized bed for restful nights, a private bathroom for post-surf rejuvenation.</p>
<p>The Agrumi Room offers the perfect blend of privacy and connection: enjoy the quietude of your own space while still being just steps away from the shared areas and friendly hostel community. Immerse yourself in the essence of Sicily and fuel your kitesurfing adventures with the Agrumi Room as your personal sanctuary.</p>
<p>You can book this room for 1 person for €75,-. We can also place an extra single bed</p>
</div>
</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space  height_large"   style="height: 64px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
<div class="vc_grid-container-wrapper vc_clearfix vc_grid-animation-fadeIn">
<div class="vc_grid-container vc_clearfix wpb_content_element vc_media_grid" data-initial-loading-animation="fadeIn" data-vc-grid-settings="{&quot;page_id&quot;:1222,&quot;style&quot;:&quot;all&quot;,&quot;action&quot;:&quot;vc_get_vc_grid_data&quot;,&quot;shortcode_id&quot;:&quot;1775917450793-dd38bc07-921a-4&quot;,&quot;tag&quot;:&quot;vc_media_grid&quot;}" data-vc-request="https://www.kitehostelstagnone.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?lang=en" data-vc-post-id="1222" data-vc-public-nonce="ba8aaa6fe8">
</div>
</div><div class="vc_empty_space  height_large"   style="height: 64px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h5>What we offer:</h5>
</div>
</div>
<div class="vc_empty_space  height_tiny"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<ul>
<li>Comfortable single bed</li>
<li>Air Conditioning</li>
<li>Towels included</li>
<li>Private bathroom just steps away from the room</li>
<li>Well equipped private bathroom</li>
<li>Cleaning and fresh bed linen if you stay longer</li>
<li>You can use all the facilities of the hostel</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h6 style="text-align: center;">From</h6>
</div>
</div>
<div class="vc_empty_space  height_tiny"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h2 style="text-align: center;">from €75,-</h2>
</div>
</div>
<div class="vc_empty_space  height_small"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
